newsitem.title: USA: Cost Plus July same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Cost Plus July same-store sales rise.

text.p: Cost Plus Inc Thursday its same-store sales for the four-weeks ended August 2, increased 10.1 percent from the same four weeks in 1996.
Same-store sales for the second quarter increased 6.8 percent, while year-to-date same-store sales increased 7.3 percent.

Total sales for the four-weeks ended August 2 were $14.6 million, a 21.7 percent increase from the $12.0 million for the four-weeks ended August 3, 1996. Total sales for the second quarter were $47.3 million, an 18.3 percent increase from $40.0 million for the same quarter last year.

Year-to-date, total sales for the 26 weeks ended August 2, were $95.8 million, a 21.1 percent increase from $79.1 million for the same period last year. As of August 2, 1997, the company operated 60 stores compared with 52 stores as of August 3, 1996.
